data.text: Research done: docs/research/payments-and-tax-2026-10.md (on disk, sources read 2026-10-19). Pilot rail: Payoneer payment request as a ФОП, money held there until the refund window closes, then withdrawn in the same quarter — NBU resolution 18 p.14 lists no refund to a non-resident for services from a Ukrainian account. Subscription later: Paddle (onboards Ukrainian sellers; forbids pure IT services, so not the pilot). Group 3, 5% + 1% military levy; limit 10,091,049 UAH in 2026; mandatory FX sale abolished 2019. Criterion 3: test with $10-20, not $1 — Payoneer's $1 minimum fee eats a $1 test. Criteria 2-4 are the owner's: accountant, test payment, bank.
